General

Aliases

None.

Time

September 1st–7th (rewards till October 1st)

Legend

A powerful ancient weapon meant to be sleeping forever has awoken deep under Vengoth. Portals all over the world lead to fragments of its shattered soul. With thirst for revenge and burning rage she will destroy the world - unless you fight her back.

Location

Vengoth

Dangers

Various (Anmothra, Chikhaton, Irahsae, Phrodomo, Teneshpar, Bloom of Doom, Cocoon, Vulnerable Cocoon, Spawn of Devovorga and the Devovorga)

Reward

World Reward

  • Increased health and mana regeneration by 50%, and XP for Extra Dimensional monsters increased by 15% for the month of September,

Possible Achievements

  • Teamplayer,
  • Daring Trespasser,
  • I Did My Part,
  • Slayer of Anmothra,
  • Slayer of Chikhaton,
  • Slayer of Irahsae,
  • Slayer of Phrodomo,
  • Slayer of Teneshpar,
  • Cocoon of Doom,
  • Devovorga's Nemesis.

Possible Individual Rewards

  • 5 Gold Ingots,
  • 3 Giant Shimmering Pearls,
  • 1 Red Gem,
  • 1 Solitude Charm,
  • 6 Small Emeralds,
  • 1 Berserk Potion,
  • 1 Mastermind Potion,
  • 1 Bullseye Potion,
  • 11 Tentacle Pieces,
  • 1 Soul Orb,
  • 1 Stone of Insight,
  • 1 Devovorga Statue,
  • 3 Demon Backpacks.

History

On August 05, 2024 this event has been revised and the following changes were introduced:

  • After Devovorga's incarnations have been defeated for a second time, her cocoon will spawn after a 5 minute delay, giving all players the opportunity to join the boss fight.
  • Devovorga will have a higher initial resilience to ensure the fight lasts longer than before.
  • For some incarnations, HP and XP have been increased.
  • Furthermore, the level ranges have been adjusted as follows:
    • Anmothra level --> no changes
    • Irahsae level 40-60 --> 40-80
    • Teneshpar level 40-80 --> 40-160
    • Chikhaton level 70+ --> 160+
    • Phrodomo level 70+ --> 160+
  • In addition to the increased health and mana regeneration by 50% as world reward, the XP for extra dimensional monsters will be increased by 15% for the month of September.
  • The Vengoth Dread Guardian now offers a new animated item in exchange for 55 Tentacle Pieces: The Bursa Obscura, a single-slot container for the backpack slot with a weight of just 1.50oz.

Spoiler • edit

This World Quest starts on September 1, and lasts for up to 7 days (until the server save on the 7th). During this time players on a whole world have to co-operate in order to be successful. If the world succeeds, it benefits from +50% health and mana regeneration until the end of September.

Required Equipment

  • Hunting supplies
  • Team work

Method

Stage 1

After the server save on September 1, travel to Vengoth and enter the energy gate on the surface by the eastern mountain (here (32948, 31521, 7)) to Devovorga's lair. You will find the NPC A Beautiful Girl - Devovorga in her human form. To wake Devovorga you must talk to her an uncertain amount of times with uncertain intervals between them.

When A Beautiful Girl wakes, Devovorga will spawn in the lair. She can be damaged in this form, but she will not die. 30 minutes after Devovorga spawns, the server will broadcast a message:

Something is rumbling deep underground all over the world.

At this point, Devovorga becomes immune, and the 5 portals that have appeared all over the Tibia continent will now function, leading to Devovorga's incarnations' lairs.

Incarnation Boss Levels Location
Soul Anmothra 20-40 Plains of Havoc, here (32635, 32330, 7)
Fury Irahsae 40-80 Drefia, here (32974, 32429, 7)
Dark Knowledge Teneshpar 40-160 Folda, here (31965, 31584, 7)
Power Chikhaton 160+ Edron, here (33325, 31743, 7)
Hatred Phrodomo 160+ Ghostlands, here (32174, 31827, 7)

Stage 2

Stage 2 begins with the server message "Devovorga has awoken.". The immortal version of Devovorga spawns immediately, and the five mini-bosses (Devovorga's incarnations) spawn exactly 30 minutes later.

The server must slay all five of Devovorga's incarnations at once and leave the room to complete Stage 2. This can potentially already be done on the first day of the event — however, the world won't progress to Stage 3 until the next server save. This is to allow more players to participate by killing the incarnations and claim rewards.

The incarnations respawn 5 minutes after being killed, so this is the time span the world has to kill all of them.

The server message "The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss! The threat ain't over yet. Watch out!" triggers once your world manages to kill all incarnations at the same time span. At this point Stage 2 is completed.

If the world failed to slay all incarnations at the same time during the whole day, Stage 2 will not be completed and the world will go back to Stage 1 at server save, with A Beautiful Girl needing to be woken up again.

Stage 3

Once Stage 2 is completed, Stage 3 will begin between 8 and 14 hours after the next server save. (The earliest this can possibly happen is on September 2, i.e. the second day of the event, at 8 hours after server save.)

Stage 3 starts with the server message "The mutation of Devovorga goes on! Fight her back!".

Blooms of Doom will now spawn in Devovorga's lair below Vengoth. Kill these with distance attacks because they have very high melee damage (9500+). Spawns of Devovorga will appear when the blooms are slain. Kill these and everyone in the area will be teleported to the previous area. Go down the hole again and kill the Spawns of Devovorga once more.

The server message "The mutation of Devovorga has been stopped - but her essence was shattered once again and formed incarnations!" now appears. The five incarnations start spawning in their respective lairs again. (For each incarnation that is killed, a new Spawn of Devovorga spawns in Devovorga’s lair.)

Just like in Stage 2, the world must slay the five incarnations at the same time. When this is done, the server message "The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss!" appears.

All players in Devovorga's lair are teleported to the area above. They must go back and, after 5 minutes, slay the Blooms of Doom and the Vulnerable Cocoon. When this is done, the server message "You destroyed Devovorga's cocoon - but not in time to stop her transformation. Kill her - or the world as you know it will end." appears. Finally, Devovorga spawns in a vulnerable form.

Focus all your firepower on Devovorga. When Devovorga is slain, the energy gate in her lair and all the incarnation portals will lead to the reward room for those who have participated in the event.

Incarnations

Soul Portal - Plains of Havoc - Level 20 to 40









































Browse Map (32635, 32330, 7)
  • Located west of the Plains of Havoc.
  • Anmothra deals a lot of fire damage. Best blocked by a Demon Skeleton summon.
Boss


7000/15000Anmothra


Fury Portal - Drefia - Level 40 to 80









































Browse Map (32974, 32429, 7)
  • Located in the northern section of Drefia, west shore.
  • Irahsae deals a lot of damage. A knight near level 60 will be needed to block.


35000/25000Irahsae


Dark Knowledge Portal - Folda - Level 40 to 160









































Browse Map (31965, 31584, 7)
  • Located on the west side of Folda.
  • Teneshpar is immune to physical and makes you drunk. It is recommended to have mages in your team to kill it.


15000/20000Teneshpar


Power Portal - Edron - Level 160+









































Browse Map (33325, 31743, 7)
  • Located north of Stonehome.
  • Chikhaton is a simple boss for 160+. He's slow and fairly weak, but it is not recommended to solo him (due to his heals).


130000/50000Chikhaton


Hatred Portal - Ghostlands - Level 160+









































Browse Map (32174, 31827, 7)
  • Located on the west side of Ghostlands, by the shore.
  • Phrodomo is a beast. Physical attacks will barely scratch him and he often hits 1500+. Bring Stone Skin Amulets and Might Rings for this fight and use Magic Shield if applicable.


150000/50000Phrodomo


Server Messages

During the quest messages will appear for the entire world to see such as:

Log-in Messages

These messages will appear in your Server Log when you log in. They can be used to determine which stage of Devovorga your world is currently on.

  • Something is rumbling deep underground all over the world. - Indicates that the quest is beginning and Devovorga has appeared.
  • An unknown evil is dwelling deep under Vengoth and strange portals have appeared all over the world... - Indicates that Devovorga minibosses are spawning on the first day of the event.
  • You might still be able to stop the evil entity that has awoken deep under Vengoth - but there is not much time left! - Indicates that Devovorga minibosses are spawning from the second day onward.
  • The shattered incarnations of Devovorga reassemble step by step. They will rise again sooner or later. Be prepared! - Indicates that the third stage will begin today or has already begun.

Once your world has defeated Devovorga, you will receive all of the following messages:

  • Thanks to the mighty and fearless Tibians who drove Devovorga back into her abyss, your regeneration and your experience gain from extra-dimensional creatures have been improved.
  • You made it - Devovorga, the incredibly powerful weapon sealed deep below Vengoth, was destroyed.
  • Upon her death, energy was released all over the world.
  • Until the month ends, it will boost your health and mana regeneration and help your fight against extra-dimensional creatures.
  • Congratulations, Tibians!

Boss Messages

These messages appear as the event progresses.

  • Devovorga has awoken. - The immortal version of Devovorga spawns and Stage 2 begins (mini bosses will spawn in 30 minutes).
  • The soul of Devovorga has risen again. - Means that the incarnation Anmothra at the Plains of Havoc has reappeared.
  • The fury of Devovorga has risen again. - Means that the incarnation Irahsae at Drefia has reappeared.
  • The dark Knowledge of Devovorga has risen again. - Means that the incarnation Teneshpar at Folda has reappeared.
  • The power of Devovorga has risen again. - Means that the incarnation Chikhaton at Edron has reappeared.
  • The hatred of Devovorga has risen again. - Means that the incarnation Phrodomo at the Ghostlands has reappeared.
  • The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss! The threat ain't over yet. Watch out! - Appears when all 5 incarnations are killed at the same time during Stage 2.

During Stage 3 the following messages are broadcast:

  • The mutation of Devovorga goes on! Fight her back! - Stage 3 has started.
  • The mutation of Devovorga has been stopped - but her essence was shattered once again and formed incarnations! - Spawns of Devovorga have been killed the first time and incarnations will spawn again.
  • The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss! - All incarnations have been killed at the same time again.
  • You destroyed Devovorga's cocoon - but not in time to stop her transformation. Kill her - or the world as you know it will end. - The Vulnerable Cocoon has been killed. Devovorga spawns now.
  • Devovorga is raging!

When succeeding the event:

  • Thanks to the mighty and fearless Tibians who drove Devovorga back into her abyss, your regeneration and your experience gain from extra-dimensional creatures have been improved.

Individual Rewards

To gain access to the reward room, players must sufficiently contribute to slaying Devovorga or one of her incarnations during the final 60 seconds of the fight. The quest log entry for Rise of Devovorga will indicate whether the player has contributed enough to be rewarded. Note that even if a player receives the achievement for killing a boss it is not necessarily the case that that player will be eligible for the rewards.

To reach the reward room after your world successfully banished Devovorga, simply enter the portal where you killed one of the incarnations or Devovorga herself. These will teleport you to the reward room, where nothing but treasure chests await you.

The reward room is only accessible until the server save on September 30th.

Level 20+

  • Statue of Devovorga
  • Stone of Insight
  • Demon Backpack containing 2 Tentacle Pieces, Berserk Potion, Mastermind Potion, Bullseye Potion and a Red Gem

Total required Capacity: 60.99 oz.

Level 40+

  • Demon Backpack containing 4 Tentacle Pieces, 6 Small Emeralds, a Soul Orb and a Solitude Charm

Required Capacity: 40.80 oz. Total required Capacity (including Level 20+ rewards): 101.79 oz.

Level 70+

  • Demon Backpack containing 5 Tentacle Pieces, 3 Blue Giant Shimmering Pearls, and 5 Gold Ingots

Required Capacity: 125.40 oz. Total required Capacity (including Level 20+ and Level 40+ rewards): 227.19 oz.

Achievements

Note that as of 2014, damaging any of the incarnations sufficiently within the final minute of the fight grants you the Slayer of... achievement for that incarnation.

  • Teamplayer — enter any of the incarnations' hideouts
  • Daring Trespasser — enter Devovorga's hideout
  • Cocoon of Doom — sufficiently damage a Bloom of Doom during the last minute of the fight
  • Devovorga's Nemesis — sufficiently damage Devovorga during the last minute of the fight
  • Slayer of Anmothra — sufficiently damage Anmothra during the last minute of the fight
  • Slayer of Irahsae — sufficiently damage Irahsae during the last minute of the fight
  • Slayer of Teneshpar — sufficiently damage Teneshpar during the last minute of the fight
  • Slayer of Chikhaton — sufficiently damage Chikhaton during the last minute of the fight
  • Slayer of Phrodomo — sufficiently damage Phrodomo during the last minute of the fight
  • I Did My Part — enter the reward room

Note: the Slayer of... achievements can also be obtained through the Devovorga's Essence Mini World Change.

World Rewards

Worlds who succeed on killing Devovorga will receive 50% extra regeneration per hour until the end of September.

Additionally, creatures in the Extra Dimensional Bestiary category will grant 15% extra experience points.
